text.tspan: Deaths from protein-energy malnutrition, by age World
Estimated annual number of deaths from protein-energy malnutrition (which results from insufficient caloric and
protein intake). Estimates come with wide uncertainties, especially for countries with poor vital registration.

tspan.tspan: Comparisons between countries and over time may be affected by differences in diagnostic practices and death certification.
